description: Five sampled drum voices, each with its own trigger, decay, filter, level and pan, mixed to a stereo pair or taken out separately.

params.text: Multiplies the kick by 1.5 and clips what goes over full scale.
Takes the kick out of the stereo mix, leaving it on its own output only.
Takes the open hat out of the stereo mix, leaving it on its own output only.
Multiplies the closed hat by 1.5 and clips what goes over full scale.
Multiplies the open hat by 1.5 and clips what goes over full scale.
Takes the closed hat out of the stereo mix, leaving it on its own output only.
Takes the snare out of the stereo mix, leaving it on its own output only.
Multiplies the clap by 1.5 and clips what goes over full scale.
Multiplies the snare by 1.5 and clips what goes over full scale.
Takes the clap out of the stereo mix, leaving it on its own output only.
Places the kick in the stereo mix, -1 hard left to +1 hard right; it has no effect on the separate output.
Sets the level of the kick, 0 to 10 on the knob for none to full gain.
Sets the level of the open hat, 0 to 10 on the knob for none to full gain.
Places the closed hat in the stereo mix, -1 hard left to +1 hard right; it has no effect on the separate output.
Places the open hat in the stereo mix, -1 hard left to +1 hard right; it has no effect on the separate output.
Sets the level of the closed hat, 0 to 10 on the knob for none to full gain.
Sets the level of the snare, 0 to 10 on the knob for none to full gain.
Places the clap in the stereo mix, -1 hard left to +1 hard right; it has no effect on the separate output.
Places the snare in the stereo mix, -1 hard left to +1 hard right; it has no effect on the separate output.
Sets the level of the clap, 0 to 10 on the knob for none to full gain.
Sets how long the kick rings out, from 80ms at the far left to 800ms at the far right.
Sets how long the open hat rings out, from 80ms at the far left to 800ms at the far right.
Sets how long the closed hat rings out, from 80ms at the far left to 800ms at the far right.
Sets how long the snare rings out, from 80ms at the far left to 800ms at the far right.
Sets how long the clap rings out, from 80ms at the far left to 800ms at the far right.
One knob for both filters on the kick: at the centre neither is in circuit, left brings in a low-pass, right a high-pass, each sweeping between 20Hz and 20kHz.
One knob for both filters on the open hat: at the centre neither is in circuit, left brings in a low-pass, right a high-pass, each sweeping between 20Hz and 20kHz.
One knob for both filters on the closed hat: at the centre neither is in circuit, left brings in a low-pass, right a high-pass, each sweeping between 20Hz and 20kHz.
One knob for both filters on the snare: at the centre neither is in circuit, left brings in a low-pass, right a high-pass, each sweeping between 20Hz and 20kHz.
One knob for both filters on the clap: at the centre neither is in circuit, left brings in a low-pass, right a high-pass, each sweeping between 20Hz and 20kHz.

inputs.text: A rising edge past 1V fires the kick sample and restarts its envelope.
A rising edge past 1V fires the closed hat sample and restarts its envelope.
A rising edge past 1V fires the open hat sample and restarts its envelope.
A rising edge past 1V fires the clap sample and restarts its envelope.
A rising edge past 1V fires the snare sample and restarts its envelope.

outputs.text: The kick on its own, at ±5V, whatever its link switch is set to.
The open hat on its own, at ±5V, whatever its link switch is set to.
The closed hat on its own, at ±5V, whatever its link switch is set to.
The snare on its own, at ±5V, whatever its link switch is set to.
The clap on its own, at ±5V, whatever its link switch is set to.
The left side of the stereo mix at ±5V, carrying every voice whose link switch is off.
The right side of the stereo mix at ±5V, carrying every voice whose link switch is off.

notes: The five samples are built into the plugin and cannot be changed. Nothing here loads a file.
The decay knob is read at the moment a voice is triggered, so turning it during a hit does not change that hit.
The panning is linear and cuts the far channel only: a voice panned halfway keeps full level on the near side.
